visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a vibrant, pastel-colored television studio featuring pink and blue arches and stylized pillar decorations. A group of five people—three men and two women—stand on a circular stage with a floor pattern resembling a yellow and white track. One man in a pink suit holds a card, while another man to his right wears a loud, multi-colored graffiti-patterned jacket. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the man in the graffiti jacket sitting on a tall stool. He points to his clothing and speaks animatedly, gesturing with his hands. A woman in a white blouse and black trousers is seated behind him on another stool. (3) The shot shifts to an easel holding a large whiteboard with Chinese text. A man in a suit points to the text while a woman in a pink and white layered dress stands nearby, holding a microphone. (4) The group engages in a game-like segment, holding circular signs with 'YES' and 'NO'. The man in the graffiti jacket moves between the 'YES' and 'NO' sides of the stage, expressing exaggerated confusion and excitement through facial expressions. (5) The final segment shows the whiteboard revealing a solution as the group reacts with surprise, mouth agape. The man in the graffiti jacket speaks directly to the camera at the end while the others wave.
